messages:
chris_customer: hey @support — we just redeemed promo code TEAM50_D but the credit landed in our hosted sandbox org (acme-sandbox) instead of our Dedicated subscription (acme-prod-ded). seeing hosted credit in console + billing page. can someone move it? grant shows as GRT-45321.

alex_support: thanks for flagging — can you paste the org ids and the code you used? also which sku were you trying to apply to (Dedicated reserved vs Hosted trial)?

chris_customer: org ids: hosted=org_0987_sandbox, dedicated=org_4521_prod-ded. promo used: TEAM50_D. intended sku: Dedicated reserved monthly. applied flow was via Console > Billing > Redeem code (GUI). no errors during redeem, it just showed success and increased hosted credit.

alex_support: copying @lia_billing and @billing-bot. we'll check allocation metadata. quick question: did you create any Dedicated subscription after redeeming? sometimes new dedicated orgs created post-redeem need manual remap.

lia_billing: seeing the grant now — GRT-45321 allocated to org_0987_sandbox (hosted). metadata: {"promo":"TEAM50_D","target_sku":"dedicated","amount":"$20k"} — promo intended Dedicated but gateway allocated to hosted org. we'll need to reassign on backend. can you confirm you want full balance moved to org_4521_prod-ded? :thinking_face:

chris_customer: yes please move full balance. we spun up dedicated nodes today so we need the credit applied there before end of day.

alex_support: next steps: billing will run a reassign. internal command (for audit) we use: ```/billing reassign-credit --grant GRT-45321 --from org_0987_sandbox --to org_4521_prod-ded --reason "promo misapplied"``` I'll ask billing to include a transaction id and update the grant record so Console shows the Dedicated allocation.

billing-bot: audit log queued. job id: JOB-8812. estimated completion ~ 30-60m.

lia_billing: kicked off JOB-8812. ran validation: current hosted balance $19,850 (some small usage). we'll pro-rate and move remaining credit of $19,850 to org_4521_prod-ded and leave hosted with $0. If you'd prefer to keep a buffer in hosted let us know.

chris_customer: move all please. thanks.

alex_support: update — JOB-8812 completed. transaction tx_202_189500. GRT-45321 now shows owner org_4521_prod-ded. please refresh Console > Billing > Credits. you should see Dedicated balance ~ $19,850 and hosted gone. also added note to grant: "Reassigned by support due to initial allocation bug; moved full balance". :white_check_mark:

chris_customer: confirmed — Dedicated shows +$19,850 and our dedicated quota increased. ran quick job, latency looks normal. huge help, thanks!

lia_billing: left follow-up task to root-cause allocation rule — filing a bug to prevent promo gateway from defaulting to hosted when promo target sku=d edicated. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1294

alex_support: closing thread after you're happy. reopen if anything odd shows up. :slightly_smiling_face:
